title: ReadingEvent
description: Internal event published by ingestion after a device reading passes validation and deduplication. Consumed by the vitals and movement modules. tenant_id and patient_id come from the device registry, never from the device payload.

patient_id.description: Null when the device is registered but not linked to a patient. Engines skip these readings.

event_time.description: When the device took the measurement (see decision 0003).

received_at.description: When ingestion received the message, server clock, UTC.
